designationHistory.indexText: Authorized by the Red River National Wildlife Refuge Act of October 13, 2000 (Public Law 106-300) and formally established in 2002 when the Fish and Wildlife Service Director approved the refuge.

authority.citation: Public Law 106-300, 114 Stat. 1055; FWS Director approval, 2002

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Red River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Public Law 106-300, Oct. 13, 2000, 114 Stat. 1055: An Act To establish the Red River National Wildlife Refuge
Federal Register, Dec. 23, 2002 (02-32210): the FWS Director "has approved the establishment of Red River National Wildlife Refuge" along the Red River Waterway in Louisiana

review.note: The 1975 sentence does not fit this refuge, which Congress authorized in 2000. Act signed by Clinton; establishment approved in 2002 (Bush administration), so no single signer is set. Confirm the exact 2002 approval date if needed.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: It was established in 1975 to protect bottomland hardwood forest and provide wintering habitat for migratory waterfowl.
